start: Actions tab, 'Store screens (Play Store app pictures)'

steps.action: Press 'Run workflow' with apk_run left empty
user_sees: Job 'build' builds an emulator APK and uploads artifact 'qa-apk' (kept 7 days)
must_not: The shots job starting before the APK exists

steps.action: Wait for job 'shots' on a Pixel 6 API 34 emulator
must_not: The run marked as a test or used as a release gate

user_sees: The Play Store app pictures from store-out, clean status bar, a real-looking member history
must_not: A real member's name or number in a picture

start: Actions tab, same workflow, with an earlier run's APK

steps.action: Type the run id of an earlier Device QA or Store screens run in apk_run and run
user_sees: Job 'build' skipped; 'APK of an earlier run' downloads that run's qa-apk
must_not: This commit built anyway (25 minutes lost)

start: apk_run holds a run id whose qa-apk has expired or never existed

user_sees: 'APK of an earlier run' fails; the shots job stops red
must_not: Pictures taken of some other app

start: A second run after the listing changed

steps.action: Run again with apk_run empty after a new version
user_sees: New pictures from this commit in a new 'store-shots' artifact
must_not: Old pictures mixed into the new artifact

start: Pictures that go on Google Play

steps.action: Read every picture before it goes on the listing
must_not: A real person's data or phone number on a public store picture
